facts.value: Prepares the fighter, changes to the requested motion, stores allow_interrupt, and clears selected fighter-kind transient fields. Where the active motion installs ftCo_Landing_IASA, that callback returns early when frame < normal_landing_lag or the stored policy is false. This is not universal across callers: Cargo Landing has NULL IASA and Hammer Landing has an empty IASA callback.

facts.value: Returns without input dispatch while cur_anim_frame < normal_landing_lag or allow_interrupt is false. Otherwise checks side special, up special (canonical ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput), neutral special, down special, grab, side/up/down smashes, side/up/down tilts, neutral attack, defensive and taunt checks, jump, dash, SquatWait, turn, and walk. First success returns. SquatWait alone also requires cur_anim_frame < normal_landing_lag + frame_speed_mul; equality at the lower lag threshold is eligible. An unordered NaN frame or lag value does not satisfy the first less-than guard, so it does not itself block the later checks.
